$$P_{\text{atm}} = \frac{2000 \text{ lb/in}^2}{14.696 \text{ lb/in}^2/\text{atm}} \approx 136.0 \text{ atm}$$

The fractional change in volume ($\Delta V / V$) due to compressibility is approximately:
$$\frac{\Delta V}{V} = -\beta \times P$$
(The negative sign indicates a decrease in volume when pressure is applied).
